description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault class, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Fault, encapsulating exception handling for XML-RPC faults within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for managing fault exception classes, observers, and creating fault instances, serving as part of the XML-RPC server fault handling mechanism.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault
classes.description: Encapsulates an exception for use as an XML-RPC fault response, with mechanisms for attaching fault exception classes, observers, and creating fault objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fault with an exception, determining fault code and message based on the exception and notifying observers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault from an exception.

methods.name: attachFaultException
methods.description: Registers exception classes that can be used to define XML-RPC faults.

methods.name: detachFaultException
methods.description: Removes exception classes from the list of recognized fault exception classes.

methods.name: attachObserver
methods.description: Attaches an observer class to monitor fault events; observer must have a static 'observe' method.

methods.name: detachObserver
methods.description: Detaches an observer class from fault monitoring.

methods.name: getException
methods.description: Returns the exception associated with this fault instance.
